card.name: Forms of the verb manage
card.fires_on: The verb manage in its forms (manage, managed, managing), including when split as MAN + AGE in capitals. It is strongest after should be or and in treatment instructions.

modes.label: Passive instruction
modes.description: managed after should be, telling how a patient or reaction is to be handled.

modes.label: Non-drug use
modes.description: managing or manage in general or computing text.
